Constants/PermissionLevel.luau.description: Permission Level provides the class/model implementation used by the Permissionservice package.

PermissionService/PermissionProviderUtil.description: Utility functions to provide/configure a permission. See [BasePermissionProvider] and [PermissionService]. Public entry points include `PermissionProviderUtils.createGroupRankConfig`, `PermissionProviderUtils.createSingleUserConfig`, `PermissionProviderUtils.createConfigFromGame`.

PermissionService/Providers/BasePermissi.description: Basic interface for providing permissions. Providers only answer questions -- [PermissionService] owns the networking and decides what reaches the client. Public entry points include `BasePermissionProvider.new`, `BasePermissionProvider.Start`, `BasePermissionProvider.PromiseIsPermissionLevel`, `BasePermissionProvider.PromiseIsAdmin`, `BasePermissionProvider.PromiseIsCreator`,…

PermissionService/Providers/CreatorPermi.description: Provides permissions from a single user creator Public entry points include `CreatorPermissionProvider.new`, `CreatorPermissionProvider.PromiseIsPermissionLevel`.

PermissionService/Providers/GroupPermiss.description: Provides permissions from a group Public entry points include `GroupPermissionProvider.new`, `GroupPermissionProvider.Start`, `GroupPermissionProvider.PromiseIsPermissionLevel`.

PermissionService/init.luau.description: Provides permissions for the game. See [BasePermissionProvider]. Permissions are static: they come from the configured provider (game group rank, or the creator's user id) and are resolved once per player as they join, then pushed to that player over [PermissionServiceNetwork]. Be sure to initialize the [PermissionServiceClient] on the client.

PermissionServiceClient/Providers/Permis.description: Holds the admin status the server pushed over [PermissionServiceNetwork]. See [PermissionServiceClient]. Only the local player's permissions are ever replicated, so this provider answers for the local player alone. Public entry points include `PermissionProviderClient.new`, `PermissionProviderClient.PromiseIsAdmin`, `PermissionProviderClient.PromiseIsUserAdmin`, `PermissionProviderClient.ObserveIsAdmin`,…

PermissionServiceClient/init.luau.description: Provides permissions on the client. See [PermissionService] for more details. Read-only: permissions are decided on the server and pushed down, so there is no setter here. Be sure to initialize the [PermissionService] on the server.

Shared/PermissionServiceNetwork.luau.description: Replicates a player's admin status from [PermissionService] to The server resolves permissions as each player joins and pushes that player their own status over `permissionsLoaded`. The server never listens for it, so a client firing it does nothing. To ask about somebody else, the client invokes the `isAdmin` query.
